trigger: A pre-launch smoke run of the C1 shuffle check gave a distinct-permutation share of 0.876 against the threshold 0.9 that I had set in SETTINGS.c1 minutes earlier. With 4,000 lines drawn uniformly from the 14,833 derangements of 8 pairs, the birthday expectation is D(1-(1-1/D)^n)/n = 0.877, so 0.9 was unreachable by construction. The design states no number for this check ('permutations differ across lines').
change: SETTINGS.c1.distinct_share 0.9 replaced by distinct_share_of_expected 0.95: the share must reach at least 95% of the uniform-draw expectation. No task, metric, margin, arm or C0/C2 rule changed; no attempt had run with the old value.

trigger: Pre-launch review: the C1 shuffle check also generated the dev train world (seed 201) to check its derangements; the design keeps dev worlds unused until C2.
change: The shuffle check runs on the technical train (4,000 lines) and test (1,000 lines) worlds only. The dev-world smoke output was not kept and no attempt ran with it; the dev worlds' lines and outcomes were not inspected.
